_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-vref-pvt-pex-boxtc on the
`klt sim` harness (issue #278). The per-experiment half of the adapter
contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and
takes every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: The box-method temperature coefficient of the closed-loop vref across the full 120-point PVT grid (5 processes x 8 temperatures x 3 supplies), through the same co-simulated closed-loop topology and the same generated PEX DUT as sim/closed-loop-vref-pvt-pex's klt bench -- every device's geometry and every wire parasitic from #272's trim-bearing re-extraction of the assembled layout/bandgap_top.gds. The box TC itself is computed per (corner, vdd) group from the 8 settled vref points by the -boxtc.csv companion (same formula, disclosure and justification policy as sim/closed-loop-vref-pvt-boxtc's committed records: box = (vmax-vmin)/(span*v27)). This is the post-layout box-TC evidence; NOT a claim against any ratified spec row -- the ratified box-TC row's own evidence lives in sim/closed-loop-vref-boxtc-trim.
Netlist provenance: layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.pex.spice (#272's trim-bearing re-extraction) + design/netlist/bandgap_top.spice (three subckts, flattened), transformed by sim/tools/gen_pex_netlist_body.py --cell top -- the DUT body is generated, never hand-transcribed.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,-20,0,27,50,75,100,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (120 points)
